dangerZoneHint: Both of these end sessions. The second one ends everything.
leaveBody: You will lose access to this dashboard. The owner will need to share it with you again if you want to return.
description: Connection, who else can touch this board, and the switches that only you can flip.
importSetupHint: Bring your commands, timers and more over from StreamElements, Moobot or StreamLabs Chatbot.
languageHint: Choose the language for your console. It is saved to your account.
themeHint: Switch the console between the dark canvas and light paper. Follows your system until you choose.
customCursorHint: Show the animated cursor across the console. Turn it off for the normal pointer. Saved to your account.
commandsPageHint: Viewers can open {url}. Off: that link answers 404 and !commands stops sharing it.
commandsPageDelayed: Saved. The public link can take up to 6 minutes to catch up.
cursorSaveError: Couldn't save your cursor preference. Try again in a moment.
reconnectTwitchHint: Re-run Twitch authorization to refresh the bot's access to your channel.
deleteAccountHint: Permanently remove your account and all of your configurations.
signOutEverywhereHint: Ends every signed-in session, including any left open on a shared or borrowed computer.
noShareLinksBody: Create one below to let a mod manage parts of your dashboard.
newShareLinkHint: Pick which sections the invitee can manage.
notificationsEmpty: Nothing yet. Messages from ItsBagelBot show up here.
nothingSharedBody: When a broadcaster shares their dashboard, it appears here.
revokeBodyConsumed: {login} immediately loses access to your dashboard. This cannot be undone.
revokeBodyPending: The link stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.
signOutEverywhereBody: Every session signs out, this one included, and you will need to sign in again. Use this if you left yourself signed in somewhere you no longer control.
deleteBody: This removes your account, commands, and any links you created. It cannot be undone.
deleteAck: I recognize that this action is irreversible and will lose all my configurations
toastClipboardBlocked: Clipboard blocked. Select the link manually.
toastCreated: Share link created. Copy it below.
accountHint: The Twitch identity every command runs as.
sharedAccessHint: Mods you have let in, and the invites still out there.
keysHint: Account-level secrets for data sources. Delegates can spend them, never read them.
deleteConfirmHint: Your channel login is {login}. Deleting is permanent.
